name: Pagination
description: A pagination navigation component that renders page number buttons with previous/next controls and optional first/last buttons. Supports ellipsis truncation via a configurable sibling count.

notes: Wraps all controls in a <nav> element with aria-label="Pagination".
The current page button has aria-current="page".
Previous button is aria-disabled when on page 1; next button is aria-disabled when on the last page.
Ellipsis spans are aria-hidden to avoid screen reader noise.
All interactive buttons have :focus-visible styling using var(--color-border-focus).

onChange.description: Called when the user navigates to a new page. Receives the target page number.

showFirstLast.description: When true, renders buttons to jump to the first and last page.

siblingCount.description: Number of page buttons to show on each side of the current page before showing an ellipsis.

labels.default: { pagination: 'Pagination', firstPage: 'Go to first page', previousPage: 'Go to previous page', nextPage: 'Go to next page', lastPage: 'Go to last page', goToPage: (page) => `Go to page ${page}` }
labels.description: Override default labels for internationalisation. PaginationLabels: { pagination, firstPage, previousPage, nextPage, lastPage: string; goToPage: (page: number) => string }.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the nav element.

do: Keep siblingCount at 1 for compact layouts and increase to 2 for wide layouts.
Always provide an onChange handler — this is a controlled component.
Show the total number of results adjacent to the pagination control when possible.
dont: Do not use pagination for fewer than 2 pages.
Do not allow currentPage to be 0 or greater than totalPages.
Do not use showFirstLast when totalPages is small — it adds noise.
